mapper.select: SELECT COUPON_ID FROM COUPON WHERE COUPON_NAME = '신규가입 3000원 쿠폰' AND IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_COUPON ( USER_ID, COUPON_ID, ISSUED_AT, EXPIRED_AT, USED_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{couponId}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), 'N', 'AVAILABLE', NOW() )
INSERT INTO COUPON_ISSUE_LOG ( USER_ID, COUPON_ID, USER_COUPON_ID, ISSUE_REASON, ISSUED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{couponId}, #{userCouponId}, #{issueReason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_COUPON_ID AS userCouponId, USER_ID AS userId, COUPON_ID AS couponId, ISSUED_AT AS issuedAt, EXPIRED_AT AS expiredAt, USED_YN AS usedYn, USED_AT AS usedAt, ORDER_ID AS orderId, STATUS AS status FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_COUPON SET USED_YN = 'Y', USED_AT = NOW(), ORDER_ID = #{orderId}, STATUS = 'USED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' AND (EXPIRED_AT IS NULL OR EXPIRED_AT >= NOW())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUPON_USE_LOG ( USER_COUPON_ID, USER_ID, COUPON_ID, ORDER_ID, USED_AT, DISCOUNT_APPLIED_AMT ) VALUES ( #{userCouponId}, #{userId}, #{couponId}, #{orderId}, NOW(), #{discountAppliedAmt} )

SELECT UC.USER_COUPON_ID, UC.USER_ID, UC.COUPON_ID, DATE_FORMAT(UC.ISSUED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS issuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(UC.EXPIRED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiredAt, UC.USED_YN, DATE_FORMAT(UC.USED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS usedAt, UC.ORDER_ID, UC.STATUS,
C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_AMT, C.DISCOUNT_RATE, C.MIN_ORDER_AMT, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT , C.ISSUE_TARGET FROM USER_COUPON UC INNER JOIN COUPON C ON UC.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE UC.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE UC.STATUS WHEN 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 WHEN 'USED' THEN 2 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, UC.EXPIRED_AT ASC, UC.ISSUED_AT DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USED_YN = 'N' AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' AND (EXPIRED_AT IS NULL OR EXPIRED_AT >= NOW())
